scenes.title: WHAT YOU KEEP
scenes.source: Sources: Ebbinghaus (1885); Murre & Dros, PLOS ONE (2015)

caption:
66% of your training is lost in 24 hours. Stop the leak. Save this for your next training plan.

Hermann Ebbinghaus measured his own memory in 1885: after 20 minutes he kept 58% of what he had learned, after a day 34%, after a month 21%. Murre & Dros replicated the forgetting curve in 2015.

Employee training that happens once fights that curve and loses. Games don't teach once:

1. Every level re-tests the last skill, a little harder
2. Short sessions, spaced out
3. Always one more try

A course is an event. A game is a loop.

Sources: Ebbinghaus, Memory (1885); Murre & Dros, PLOS ONE (2015).
